summary: Iter78 frontend regression complete — 7/7 flows exercised, 6 clean PASS, 1 non-blocking display-name rehydration bug found. Verified: strict verify-email gate blocks bypass (staying-on-screen message + direct-URL redirects for /, /(tabs)); spam/junk helper text visible (testID gate-spam-hint); Mongo-based verification proceeds to profile-setup with display name TA-QA prefilled; profile-completion gate holds until required fields present; completing bio/city/photos(via API)/3 interests → choose-vibe → vibe-details?next=tabs; final /api/auth/me shows profile_required_complete=true; unverified fresh account log-in lands on Verify Email. OpenStreetMap tiles render on radar with no 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark anywhere in the DOM. Profile tab renders clean with radius/plan/visible row.

ui_bugs.issue: Display name field is NOT re-hydrated when the profile-setup screen mounts before user context is ready (e.g. direct URL navigation, re-visit after redirect). useState initialiser reads user?.display_name, but the useEffect hydration block only re-sets bio/interests/photos — display_name is missed. Reproduction: goto /(tabs) → gate redirects to /(auth)/profile-setup → field is empty for a beat and, if the user does not re-type, submit fails with 'Please choose a display name'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/profile-setup.tsx:32,46-53

action_items: Add displayName to the hydration useEffect in profile-setup.tsx so users returning to the screen see the value already saved in their account (e.g. setDisplayName((user as any)?.display_name || user?.name || '')).
Optional: On the verify-email gate, keep the message shown longer (currently disappears after re-check) so users understand why they are still on the page.
critical_code_review_comments: verify-email.tsx checkVerified() correctly branches to profile-setup / choose-vibe / tabs based on backend flags — good use of backend as source of truth.
app/index.tsx and (tabs)/_layout.tsx Redirect guards are symmetric (email_verified → profile_required_complete → vibe) and align with server-side gate.
MapTiles.tsx now uses keyless https://tile.openstreetmap.org — no API key watermark. Attribution '© OpenStreetMap contributors' rendered. LGTM.
profile-setup.tsx: hydration useEffect misses display_name and city/home_city/country (only bio/interests/photos are re-set). Consider extending it to cover all editable fields.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (6/7 flows clean; 1 minor UI hydration bug)

seed_data_creation: Two QA accounts (qa.ta78.ku63ne@example.com, qa.ta78.p6r00y@example.com) created and CLEANED UP at end of run via /tmp/qa_helper.py cleanup (users deleted from users collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter78 verify-email + profile gates + OSM tiles verified end-to-end. Only outstanding UI issue: profile-setup does not re-hydrate display_name on remount (see action_items). QA account cleanup helper at /tmp/qa_helper.py. Demo login shortcut on /(auth)/login → 'Explore Demo' still works; localStorage key is 'auth_token' (JSON-stringified string).
rca_of_issue: profile-setup hydration bug: in /app/frontend/app/(auth)/profile-setup.tsx the initial useState for displayName runs before AuthContext.user is available (user is null on first render for direct URL loads). The subsequent hydration useEffect (lines 46-53) only re-syncs bio/interests/photos, so displayName remains empty. Fix: add `setDisplayName((user as any)?.display_name || user?.name || '')` inside the same block. Same treatment recommended for city/country/homeCity to avoid the same latent issue.
